prompt:
Edit reference image 1, the existing nine-card blueprint sheet. Reference image 2 shows the original objects and is for preserving exact recognizable silhouettes and viewing angles. Keep the same order, teal-blue rounded card style, thin white/pale-blue unfilled line drawing, faint grid. Make a revised 3x3 blueprint card sheet with SIGNIFICANTLY MORE INNER PADDING.

HIGHEST PRIORITY: Each card has identical square size and corner radius. On each card use coordinates 0..100%. ALL object lines AND ALL dimension arrows must fit entirely inside the CENTRAL 65% rectangle: x=17.5%..82.5%, y=17.5%..82.5%. Leave a completely illustration-free safety band at least 17.5% wide around all four edges; only faint background grid may appear there. Especially keep RIGHT edge wide and empty. Do NOT enlarge complex objects to fill the card. Shrink the drawings generously.

CENTERING: center the OBJECT ITSELF at x=50%,y=50% of each card. Its longest dimension should be only 48-52% of card width (around half the card). This small object size is deliberate. All nine object drawings must have generous breathing room. Do not let wheels, drone propellers, bubbles, lock, external greenhouse controller or parcel poke outside safe area.
DIMENSIONS: EXACTLY TWO dimension arrows per card, unlabelled. One strictly HORIZONTAL double-headed arrow BELOW the object at y=79%, from x=27% to73%. One strictly VERTICAL double-headed arrow on LEFT at x=21%, from y=28% to70%. NO arrows on right, NO diagonal dimension arrows, NO arrows on top, NO extra extension lines or drafting symbols. All arrows remain entirely within central65% area. Object bounds roughly x=26%..76%,y=25%..75% so arrows do not touch objects. Do not draw guides or safe-area boxes.

CARDS: uniform deep teal-blue around #17627d, faint low-contrast square graph-paper grid, same rounded corners. Nine separate cards in a 3x3 grid, equal generous gutters and outer margin. Transparent outside cards. No drop shadows.
DRAWING: white/pale sky-blue thin uniform line art, NO colored fills or solid white object fills; the blue grid shows through objects. Cute simple cartoon game-item blueprints, not complex mechanical drawings. No text, letters, digits, titles, labels, captions, measurements or fake writing.

ORDER:
row1: round smart speaker with top ring/button; wheelchair in original 3/4 view; compact autonomous car with roof sensor.
row2: tilted globe-screen phone with two speech bubbles; four-rotor pest drone above leaf/bug; box delivery robot carrying parcel.
row3: four-rotor passenger drone taxi; face-recognition phone with open padlock; greenhouse with sprouts and attached controller.

Use image1's exact cartoon drawing style and image2's design/angle. Important correction from image1: reduce all object sizes to about HALF card width, keep the objects centered, move ALL vertical dimensions to LEFT, make ALL bottom dimensions horizontal, ensure all four margins wide and equal. Nine matching cards, one square sheet.
